releases.body:
## Changes
- Support OpenCode 1.18.29+ alongside OpenCode 2 with a V1 `server()` entrypoint.
- Keep `grok_image` and `grok_video` available in both versions, sharing their generation logic.
- Add an OpenCode 1 `opencode.json` example with `apiKey` and V1/V2 compatibility tests.

Published package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-grok-imagine/v/1.0.2

## Changes
- Update npm package description, search keywords, and repository/homepage/issues links for the renamed repository.
- Expand README configuration documentation, including an `opencode.json` example with `apiKey` and all supported options.

Published package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-grok-imagine/v/1.0.1
